BGP_INTERNAL_TEST.desc: Load bgp internal neighbor table with ipv4 and ipv6 neighbors.

BGP_INTERNAL_INVALID_ASN_TEST.desc: Load bgp internal neighbor table with ipv4 neighbor having incorrect asn.
eStr: Internal iBGP neighbors should have same ASN as defined in device metadata

BGP_INVALID_LOCAL_ADDRESS_FAMILY_TEST.desc: Load bgp internal ipv4 neighboripv6 local address.
eStr: local address and neighbor address family doesnt match

BGP_LOCAL_ADDRESS_ABSENT_TEST.desc: Load bgp internal neighbor table no local address.
eStr: Mandatory local_addr is missing for numbered neighbor

BGP_INTERNAL_NEG_MULTILINE_NAME.desc: Internal BGP neighbor description contains a newline.

BGP_INTERNAL_VLAN_NEIGHBOR_VALID.desc: A BGP_INTERNAL_NEIGHBOR on an existing VLAN is accepted.

BGP_INTERNAL_VLAN_NEIGHBOR_MISSING.desc: A BGP_INTERNAL_NEIGHBOR naming a VLAN that does not exist is refused.

BGP_INTERNAL_SUBINTF_NEIGHBOR_VALID.desc: A BGP_INTERNAL_NEIGHBOR on an existing VLAN sub-interface is accepted.

BGP_INTERNAL_SUBINTF_NEIGHBOR_MISSING.desc: A BGP_INTERNAL_NEIGHBOR naming a VLAN sub-interface that does not exist is refused.

BGP_INTERNAL_VLAN_NEIGHBOR_4095.desc: A BGP_INTERNAL_NEIGHBOR on Vlan4095 is refused.
